title: Message structure — boundary or continuity evidence
requirement: Handle a message with no attachments or no HTML part.
verification_procedure: Exercise the stated edge, transition, recovery, uncertainty, or sensitivity case using the original approved oracle. Compare before-and-after state or conclusions; retain ordering, timing, and version context where relevant.
pass_criteria: The edge-case outcome follows the approved specification, preserves required invariants, and exposes unresolved or partial outcomes instead of fabricating certainty. Any changed assumption is reviewed.

evidence_required.kind: boundary or continuity result and reconciliation record

independent_reviewer_role: Independent technical verifier; domain specialist where applicable
applicability_rule: Assess when BVE-C056 is selected and the stated surface exists; otherwise require an approved, reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE decision. Missing specification, unavailable evidence, or a failed test is not non-applicability.

provenance.source_role: Context for the mechanism; not evidence that this control is source-prescribed, implemented, or passed.
